name: codebase-design
title_zh: 深模块接口设计词汇表：把接缝画在该画的地方
tagline_zh: 改一个接口前先问：这个模块的复杂度是被藏起来了还是被推给了调用方？它给你一套能当场吵起来的具体词——深度、接缝。
tagline_en: Before touching an interface, ask: is this module hiding complexity or dumping it on callers? You get concrete.
desc_en: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
why_zh: 它不生成代码，只提供判断接口好坏的共享词汇。当你说「这里该有条接缝」时。
why_en: It ships no code, only shared vocabulary for judging interfaces. Say 'there's a seam here' and everyone knows you mean a.
limit_zh: 只给词汇和判断标准，不产出重构后的代码，也不做依赖图分析；模块边界本身模糊、或团队没人愿意先统一术语时。
limit_en: Vocabulary and judgment criteria only — no refactored code, no dependency-graph analysis. If module boundaries are already fuzzy or the team won't.
title_en: Deep-Module Vocabulary: Put the Seam Where It Belongs
